text:
alyssa: heads-up: i want to run a micro-probe that sticky-routes ~5% of tenant requests from v1 -> v2 for two days to validate perf + regressions
ben: ok. what's the exact stickiness window and how do we guarantee isolation?
alyssa: plan: sticky for 7 days after first probe hit, cohort chosen by hashed tenant id; add routing_tag=soft_v2_probe_mar2026
carmen: console & billing concerns: do we surface this as a per-tenant badge? and will token counting affect their quota?
alyssa: propose badge + tooltip on tenant page and keep billing on the same quota (no double-billing). we will shadow-increment a v2_probe metric for analysis only.
dmitri: telemetry: we need distinct labels in metrics to slice probe traffic without exploding cardinality. use probe_name + outcome label; avoid tenant_id on high-rate counters. trace/span: add attribute probe=true + probe_name.
nina-ui: UI mock suggestions: small muted badge "v2 probe — 5%" next to runtime config, click shows modal with opt-out CTA. opt-out should be immediate and sticky.
ben: rollback rules? define alerts: error_rate > baseline*1.5 for 5m OR latency_p95 > baseline + 150ms for 10m -> auto-disable flag.
alyssa: correct. also plan a manual rollback path: infra CLI to flip cohort off and a tenant opt-out flow in console.
carmen: opt-out audit: record event to audit-log with actor, timestamp, and reason. send confirmation email.
dmitri: cache isolation: important — v2 model has KV layout changes. probe must use separate kv_namespace to avoid evicting v1 caches. add header kv-namespace: v2_probe_mar2026.
alyssa: noted. i'll mark route metadata with kv_namespace and model_variant.
ben: can we smoke-test locally? small harness: 5k requests, assert routing distribution 5% ±1% and no spike in 500s. add to CI as gated smoke.
alyssa: will add smoke test. sample config i'll push as a feature-flag JSON: ```{ "name":"soft_v2_probe_mar2026", "percent":5, "sticky_days":7, "auto_disable_on_error_rate":0.015 }```
ops-bot: scheduled: feature-flag soft_v2_probe_mar2026 will roll to staging at 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
dmitri: metrics names proposal: routing.probe.requests{probe_name, outcome}, routing.probe.latency_p95{probe_name}, routing.probe.errors{probe_name, error_type}. keep tenant_id only on sampled spans.
alyssa: agreed. set sampling rate for traces to 0.5% for probe traffic, 0.05% for non-probe.
nina-ui: will deliver badge mock and opt-out modal by EOD, plus copy for the confirmation email.
carmen: console copy: short, non-technical: "Your tenant was included in a small test of v2 routing (5% of traffic). Opting out will route all traffic to v1 immediately." include link to docs.
\en: (note) watch for billing dashboard leakage — ensure billing dashboards aggregate by billing token not probe label.
ben: one more: telemetry retention window for probe metrics should be 90d so we can compare baseline over time.
dmitri: will add dashboard slices: baseline cohort vs probe cohort, latency/err/hallucination-proxy (we'll surface prompt-truncation and safety-filter hits).
alyssa: action list: (1) i open flag PR + smoke test (2) @nina-ui pushes badge + modal (3) @dmitri wires metrics, alerts, traces sampling (4) @carmen prepares opt-out wording & audit events
ben: schedule a 30m sync 24h after staging roll to review initial signals and decide expansion.
alyssa: calendar invite sent for Fri 11:00am PT. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2378 (soft_v2_probe_mar2026)
dmitri: small follow-up: keep probe_name low-cardinality (don't include tenant suffix). if we need per-tenant diagnosis, rely on sampled traces and longtail logs.
alyssa: yep — probe_name will be static. closing thread for now, will paste PR + smoke results when ready.
